The TE Connectivity 5520258-2 is a single-port, vertical (straight) modular RJ14 jack designed for through-hole PCB mounting. Commonly used in telecom and data communications applications (like 10Base-T networks), this unshielded connector features a 6P4C configuration (6 positions, 4 loaded contacts).

Technical Specifications

• Connector Type: RJ14 Jack (Female)
• Configuration: 1x1 Port, 6P4C (6 Positions, 4 Contacts)
• Orientation: Vertical / Straight (Top Entry)
• Mounting Type: Through Hole (Solder termination)
• Performance Rating: Cat 3 (suited for voice and basic data up to 10 Mbps)
• Shielding: Unshielded (UTP)
• Mechanical Features: Includes board locks (for stable PCB alignment) and panel stops
• Material: Thermoplastic PBT housing (UL 94V-0 rated) with gold-plated phosphor bronze contacts
• Operating Temperature: -40°C to 85°C
